verdict.description: PASS only if there are no blocker/major defects and the plan was implemented as specified.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was reviewed and the overall judgement.

defects.description: Concrete, reproducible defects. Empty when verdict is PASS. No vague 'looks risky' notes.

file.description: Repo-relative path, with :line when a specific line is implicated.

symptom.description: One sentence stating what is wrong.

evidence.description: Why it is wrong: failing input/state, expected-vs-actual, or the plan requirement it violates.
